title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Security Deposit Terms by Tier
content:
**Admission agreement, financial terms — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The refundable security deposit terms are identical across all six accommodation tiers.

| Term | All six tiers |
|---|---|
| Deposit collected at private-pay admission | 30 days of the tier's current daily rate |
| Payer sources for which no deposit may be requested or held | Medicare Part A, Medicaid pending, Medicaid (Medicare and Medicaid conditions of participation) |
| Time within which the deposit is applied or refunded after discharge or payer conversion | 30 calendar days |
| How the deposit is disposed of | Applied to the open balance first; any remainder refunded |

**Questions the terms answer.**
- *How many days of the daily rate make up the admission deposit?* 30.
- *May a deposit be held while the stay is billed to Medicaid pending?* No; Medicaid pending is one of the three payer sources for which no deposit may be requested or held.
- *What happens to the deposit at disposition?* It first pays the open balance; only what remains is refunded.
